title: Applying Our Logo
slide_intent: Relate the signature to the composition’s scale because recognition should remain stable as the format changes.
strategic_value: A margin-based logo size can give Burger King a consistent signature while allowing extra visibility on billboards.
demonstration: Three layouts place logos at bottom right and label logo widths 54 px for 27 px margins and 60 px for 30 px margins.
practical_value: Start with a logo width twice the margin and use the billboard exception when viewing distance requires it.

content_islands.name: Logo placement rule
content_islands.spec: Place the general location, scale rule and billboard exception at upper left.

content_islands.name: Signature diagrams
content_islands.spec: Show logos within all three numbered layouts, with edge and width measurements.

content_islands.name: Size calculations
content_islands.spec: List the three twice-margin calculations below the guidance.

ingredient.name: Margin-scaled logo
ingredient.application: Generally place the logo bottom right with width twice the margin. For billboards, increase size for visibility at designer discretion using the examples as optical reference.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. Bottom-right is a general placement, not an absolute prohibition on alternatives.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text says the rule ensures proportional logo scaling and allows billboard enlargement for visibility.
reference_purposes.Application: The diagrams place the signature and show 27×2=54 px and 30×2=60 px.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Logo width should be 2× margin; bottom-right placement is described as general, with billboard enlargement at designer discretion.
